Name: Custom Emotes Menu
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[size=4]This mod introduces a brand-new custom emote menu that can be accessed at any time during gameplay. When activated, the menu displays a variety of custom emojis that players can use to express themselves![/size]

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pV0Tk99L/for-user-s-1.png[/img][/center]

[b][size=4][center]Accessing the Emote Menu[/center][/size][/b]
[size=4]
To [b][color=#00ff00]open[/color][/b] the [b][color=#00ff00]emoji menu[/color][/b], use the key or controller button set in the mod’s config.
Default: [b][color=#00ff00]Q[/color][/b] for keyboard, [b][color=#00ff00]DPadDown[/color][/b] for controller.
[/size]

[b][size=4][center]Using Emotes[/center][/size][/b]
[size=5]Browse through [b]available emoji[/b] and [b]select one[/b] to express how you're feeling!
The selected emoji will appear above your character’s head to show your [color=#9900ff][b]mood[/b][/color] or [color=#ff7700][b]reaction[/b][/color] to [color=#00ff00][b]friends[/b][/color] and [color=#00ff00][b]NPCs[/b][/color].[/size]

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/VsBKr8Vw/Muliplayer-showcase-ezgif-com-video-to-gif-converter.gif[/img][/center]

[b][size=5]⭐ Setting Favorite Emojis[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]On Keyboard:[/size][/b]
[size=4]Hold [b][color=#00ff00]Ctrl[/color][/b] + [b][color=#00ff00]1[/color][/b], [b][color=#00ff00]2[/color][/b], [b][color=#00ff00]3[/color][/b], or [b][color=#00ff00]4[/color][/b] while clicking an emoji with the [b][color=#00ff00]left mouse button[/color][/b] to assign it as a favorite.
To use a favorite, just open the emoji menu and press the corresponding key ([color=#00ff00]1–4[/color]).[/size]

[b][size=4]On Controller:[/size][/b]
[size=4]Hold [b][color=#00ff00]Left Shoulder (LB)[/color][/b] + [b][color=#00ff00]LT[/color][/b], [b][color=#00ff00]RT[/color][/b], [b][color=#00ff00]DPadUp[/color][/b], [b][color=#00ff00]DPadRight[/color][/b], or [b][color=#00ff00]DPadLeft[/color][/b] to assign a favorite emoji.
To use it, just open the emoji menu and press the assigned button again.[/size]

[size=4][b]🧩 Creating Your Own Custom Emoji: A Guide for Modders[/b][/size]

📁 [b]Step 1: Folder Structure[/b]
Your content pack should follow this layout:
[code]
YourEmojiPack/
├── assets/
│ ├── YourEmoji.png
│ ├── AnotherEmoji.png
├── cfg.json
└── manifest.json
[/code]

📝 [b]Step 2: manifest.json Example[/b]
[code]
{
"Name": "NameForPack",
"Author": "YourName",
"Version": "1.0",
"Description": "Terraria Emoji Pack",
"UniqueID": "YourName.NameForPack",
"ContentPackFor": {
"UniqueID": "Zexu2K.NewEmotes",
"MinimumVersion": "2.2"
}
}
[/code]

🎨 [b]Step 3: Create Emoji Graphics[/b]
Use the included [b][color=#00ff00]template.png[/color][/b] (found in the [b]main mod folder[/b]) to align your artwork.
[b]Green lines are helper guides[/b] showing the [b]center of the emoji bubble[/b], making positioning easier.
Each emoji must be exactly [b]64×64 pixels[/b] and use a transparent background.

📝 [b]Step 4: cfg.json Format[/b]
Your [color=#00ff00][b]cfg.json[/b][/color] file should look like this:
[code]
{
"Tongue": "Tongue.png",
"Happy": "HappyEmoji.png",
"Wave": "wave.png"
}
[/code]

By following this guide, you can create custom emojis that integrate seamlessly into the in-game emote system!

[size=3][b]Note:[/b] For custom emoji to work in multiplayer, [b]all players must have the same emoji files installed.[/b][/size]
